scripts.test:all: pnpm test:quality && pnpm test:sql && pnpm test:e2e:local
scripts.test:quality: pnpm --filter web typecheck && pnpm --filter web lint && pnpm --filter web test && pnpm --filter web build && pnpm db-types:check
scripts.test:sql: PGPASSWORD=postgres PGHOST=localhost PGPORT=54322 PGUSER=postgres PGDATABASE=postgres psql -h localhost -p 54322 -U postgres -d postgres -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f supabase/tests/run_all.sql
scripts.test:e2e:local: E2E_MODE=full-local E2E_BASE_URL=http://localhost:4173 pnpm --filter web exec playwright test --project=chromium
scripts.test:e2e:deploy: E2E_MODE=deploy-smoke E2E_BASE_URL=https://app.ledjer.id pnpm --filter web exec playwright test e2e/smoke.spec.ts e2e/security-public.spec.ts e2e/static-routes.spec.ts --project=chromium
scripts.test:e2e:cross-browser-smoke: E2E_CROSS_BROWSER=1 pnpm --filter web exec playwright test e2e/smoke.spec.ts e2e/accessibility.spec.ts e2e/responsive.spec.ts --project=firefox --project=webkit
scripts.test:visual: pnpm --filter web exec playwright test e2e/visual.spec.ts --project=chromium
scripts.test:perf: pnpm --filter web exec playwright test e2e/performance.spec.ts --project=chromium
scripts.test:a11y: pnpm --filter web exec playwright test e2e/accessibility.spec.ts --project=chromium
